record.name: Mailchimp
record.one_liner: Mailchimp provides developer tools including a Marketing API, Transactional API, and Open Commerce GraphQL API for building intelligent marketing, email, and commerce integrations.

auth.notes: API keys are the simplest way to authenticate requests to the Marketing and Transactional APIs, while OAuth 2 is available for integrations built for multiple users.

access.notes: Developers can create an account and generate an API key directly from their account settings.

api_surface.notes: Supports REST (Marketing and Transactional APIs), GraphQL (Open Commerce), and webhooks.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.
